summary.intent: Merge the latest changes from main into the current feature branch and resolve any conflicts that arose.
summary.outcome: Successfully merged main into the feature branch, resolving a conflict in .release-please-manifest.json by preserving main's version entries while adding the new crate entries from the feature branch.

repo: The cipher-box repo uses release-please for versioning, and .release-please-manifest.json tracks versions per crate — merge conflicts here require keeping main's released versions while integrating new crate entries from feature branches.

code.finding: Contains per-crate version entries; during merges, main's versions must take precedence over feature branch versions while new crate entries from the feature branch are preserved.

workflow: When merging main into a feature branch in a release-please repo, version conflicts in the manifest should resolve in favor of main's versions to avoid rolling back published releases.

friction: Merge conflict in .release-please-manifest.json required manual inspection and a deliberate resolution strategy to avoid corrupting release version history.
open_items: PR #352 (which includes a security review report) is still open and awaiting review/merge.
